## Formal {.unnumbered}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| echo: true
mat1 <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 3)
mat2 <- matrix(7:2, nrow = 3)

mat1 + 1
mat1 / 2

mat1 - mat2
mat1 * mat2

## Example of setting row and column names
mdat <- matrix(c(1,2,3, 11,12,13), nrow = 2, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE,
               dimnames = list(c("row1", "row2"),
                               c("C.1", "C.2", "C.3")))
mdat


mat1 %*% 1:2

```
